role_voices.text_zh: 你長得還滿符合我胃口的嘛～
role_voices.text_en: You look like you might be my type~

role_voices.text_zh: 最近越來越難從亞特蘭提斯偷跑出來了……
role_voices.text_en: It's been getting harder to sneak out of Atlantis lately...

role_voices.text_zh: 噓、小聲一點！你想害我偷懶被發現嗎！
role_voices.text_en: Shh, quiet! Are you trying to get me caught slacking off?
What affair? This is a chance encounter!

role_voices.text_zh: 海很漂亮對吧？我身上有更漂亮的地方哦～
role_voices.text_en: Isn't the sea beautiful? But there's a part of me that's even more beautiful~

role_voices.text_zh: 怎麼了？還想和我「打」一場嗎？
role_voices.text_en: What's the matter? Want to go another "round" with me?

role_voices.text_zh: 就算在海裡，也是會擦槍走火的哦♥
role_voices.text_en: Even under the ocean, sparks can fly♥

role_voices.text_zh: 既然現在沒事，要不要「摸魚」一下？
role_voices.text_en: If you're free right now, want to go "slack off" with me?

role_voices.text_zh: 說吧，你想從我身上得到什麼？
role_voices.text_en: Tell me, what do you want from me?
